item.title: Seattle Seahawks defeat New England Patriots to win Super Bowl LX
item.description: Seattle’s punishing defense set the tone from start to finish, powering the Seahawks to a convincing 29-13 victory over the New England Patriots in Super Bowl LX on Sunday night at Levi’s Stadium in Santa Clara, Calif.
